title: Add the design role and the bee-design agent, pinned for design cells
action:
RED FIRST: write the failing tests before the code and watch each fail for its own reason.

(1) ROLE (per D3). Add `design` to the seeded team table in onboard/templates.rs `default_config()` (the `"team": { "claude": {` literal; anchor line `"code": { "model": "sonnet", "description": "write the cell's code and its tests" },`) with model sonnet and the description `build and critique rendered UI with the bee-design taste; proves with the design gate`. team.pi derives from team.claude, so it follows. Mirror the row in .bee/config-sample.json with its teaching line.

(2) AGENT. Add packages/bee/agents/bee-design.md.tmpl modelled on bee-build.md.tmpl: it executes exactly one claimed cell like bee-build (reserve, write, commit, cap), and additionally loads the bee-design skill and any installed bee-design-* pack before writing UI, follows its workflow, and records the design check as its proof, saying plainly when Node is missing and the check did not run. Register it everywhere bee-build is registered: AGENT_ROLES_BY_NAME in templates.rs (anchor `("bee-build", &["generation"]),`) as ("bee-design", &["design", "generation"]); the opencode permission deny row (same list as bee-build); prompt.rs `AGENT_*` include_str! and the `embedded_agent_body` match arm; agent_job_summary in guard.rs; and the PINNED_AGENT_TYPE mirror in hooks/model_guard.rs if it lists agent names. ALSO add ("design", "bee-design") to ROLE_AGENTS in guard.rs (`pub(crate) const ROLE_AGENTS: [(&str, &str); 4] = [` — the array length changes) so role_for_agent and the model guard accept the pin. The template says what the worker does when no bee-design skill is installed in the host: it reports that the taste is absent and works as a plain cell executor.

(3) PIN. In prepare.rs at `let pinned_type = if kind == "cell" {` a cell dispatch pins bee-build unconditionally. Make it pin bee-design when the cell's role (the resolved marker_role or the cell record's role) is `design`, and bee-build for every other role. The herding path (`kind == "cell" && is_herding`) sends the bare prompt body with no agent body, so for a design cell also put a short design preamble (load bee-design and installed packs, prove with the design check, say so when Node is missing) into the prompt body itself; both transports then carry it.

(4) Run `bee dev regen` (dob-1 has capped, so packages/bee/design is complete) so .claude/agents/bee-design.md, the opencode agent and the release manifest are written. Confirm afterwards that `fd -t d bee-design .claude-plugin .codex-plugin skills` prints nothing.

Tests: a --kind cell dispatch for a cell with role design returns subagent_type bee-design and the model-guard check accepts that payload; the same with role code returns bee-build; a herding design cell's prompt carries the preamble; the seeded config lists design under team.claude and team.pi; onboard renders .claude/agents/bee-design.md.

bee team show on a freshly onboarded host lists design
